register.labelZh: MARK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: mark something down 和 mark something up 能讓你直接描述減價和加價。；mark somebody down 能幫助你說明學生為何被扣分。；mark something off 和 mark something out 適合用來談論安全範圍、運動場地、路線和物件位置。；mark somebody down as something 可以表達對某人的看法;mark somebody out 則可以說明某人為何顯得與眾不同。
register.summaryEn: Mark something down and mark something up let you describe reductions and increases in prices directly. Mark somebody down helps you explain why a student received a lower score. Mark something off and mark something out are useful when discussing safety areas, sports grounds, routes and the positions of objects. Mark somebody down as something expresses an opinion about a person, while mark somebody out explains what makes that person different from others.

When using him, her, it, us or them, place the word as shown: mark him down as a good player mark her down mark it off mark them out mark it down mark it up Some expressions look similar but have different meanings: mark somebody down = deduct marks mark something down = reduce its price mark somebody out = make the person seem different mark something out = draw or show its shape or position
